name: InterContinental Amstel Amsterdam
positioning: Historic grand hotel, known as the Amstel Hotel, on the banks of the Amstel River in the heart of Amsterdam, welcoming guests since 1867, with Delft-blue-accented rooms and a river-level indoor pool
best_for: Travelers who want a historic riverside base in central Amsterdam
Guests who value a heated indoor pool and wellness club with river views

facts.text: The hotel welcomed its first guests in 1867 and is known as the Grand Dame of Amsterdam.
The hotel sits along the banks of the Amstel River in the heart of Amsterdam.
Conde Nast Traveler describes a 19th-century hotel on the outer edge of the canal ring, with a white-columned entrance and a lobby of marble floors and a vaulted ceiling.
Rooms and suites are appointed with Dutch period furniture, plush drapes, delicate wall patterns and handcrafted Delft blue pottery.
Classic Rooms may include a river view or a city view.
The Champagne Suite may include a balcony and a river view.
Conde Nast Traveler notes marble bathrooms with rainfall showers and a separate bath and toilet.
The large heated indoor pool offers a river-level view of Amsterdam.
The Amstel Health & Fitness Club includes a sauna, steam cabin and Jacuzzi.
The Amstel Lounge sits beneath a dome with river views and is known for its seasonal afternoon tea.
The hotel restaurant overlooks the Amstel River.
Private historical saloon boats leave from the hotel's quayside for tours of the UNESCO-listed Amsterdam canals.

highlights.text: Welcoming guests since 1867, the hotel is known as the Grand Dame of Amsterdam.
The large heated indoor pool offers a river-level view of Amsterdam.
Rooms feature Dutch period furniture and handcrafted Delft blue pottery.
Canal tours on private historical saloon boats depart from the hotel's own quayside.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed, except certified guide dogs and service animals.
The Rijksmuseum is about 2.5 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the historic building has traditional room layouts.
